environment.observationDefinition: hard navigation → DOMContentLoaded → fixed observationMs without interaction; ready/LCP times are still measured from navigation timeOrigin

cacheDefinition.cold: new BrowserContext; only blank origin + IndexedDB seeded before hard navigation
cacheDefinition.warm: second hard navigation in same context with HTTP cache enabled

environment.media: real native MediaRecorder WebM from isolated synthetic fake devices; separate after-only group
environment.aiInference: not measured; model requests blocked equally without Playwright routing (which would disable HTTP cache)
environment.interpretation: Experimental p75 is not real-user p75. RAF intervals are rendering opportunities, not measured FPS.

mediaSeek.seekDefinition: real slider pointer click → native media non-seeking at accepted target + expected visible code first line → two RAF opportunities
